confirm.subject: Confirm the reset of your authenticator
confirm.body:
Hello,

You asked to reset the authenticator of your account. To confirm it, open this link:

{{enlace}}

After 48 hours, on {{fecha}}, you will be able to sign in with the email code and set up a new authenticator.

If you didn't ask for it, do nothing: without confirmation, the reset does not go ahead.

Armando Duarte's team

notice.subject: Notice: a reset of your authenticator was requested
notice.body:
Hello,

Someone asked to reset the authenticator of your account. If it was you, just confirm it from the other email.

If it was NOT you, cancel it from this link and your authenticator stays as it is:

{{enlace}}

Armando Duarte's team
